title: 第938章 叶无双第937章 拯救荒仙
lines: 就连一直在无归时空海坐镇的叶遮天始祖和叶北辰始祖，都齐齐赶了回来。
这件大事，便是……叶无缺和玉娇雪的孩子，怀胎了一千二百年，终于要出生了！
叶无缺的子嗣，这太重要了。
代表着叶无缺生命的延续。
而且，不少叶族生灵都已经知道了，这个还没出生的孩子，也是一个足以颠覆认知的无上妖孽！
尚在娘胎之中，便已自行吞吐天地灵气，修炼悟道，气息之强，早已超越了道境层次。
如今临盆在即，整个雪瑶殿都被霞光笼罩，隐隐有金龙虚影在殿顶盘旋，龙吟之声隐隐可闻。
异象纷呈，昭示着这个孩子的不凡。
雪瑶殿外的庭院里，站满了人。
叶遮天始祖身着青色道袍，须发皆白，却精神矍铄，目光紧紧盯着殿门，双手背在身后，指尖却微微有些收紧，显露出内心的紧张。
叶北辰始祖站在他身侧，一身白衣，面容冷峻，可微微蹙起的眉头，也暴露了他并不平静的心情。
叶太上始祖站在最前方，苍老的脸上满是期待与忐忑。
天祖、玄祖、大祖、七祖等一众老祖，族长叶惊鸿，七长老等核心长老，也都悉数到场。
所有人都屏住了呼吸，紧张无比地等着叶无缺子嗣的出生。
庭院里安静得可怕，连呼吸声都清晰可闻。
只有殿内，偶尔传来玉娇雪压抑的痛哼声，揪着每一个人的心。
“太上始祖，您说……少夫人和小少主都会没事吧？”
七长老忍不住开口，声音带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖。
叶太上始祖沉声道：
“吉人自有天相。”
“娇雪福缘深厚，无缺的孩子更是天命所归，一定会平安无事的。”
话虽如此，可他紧握的拐杖，却泄露了他内心的不安。
时间，一分一秒地过去。
每一刻，都显得格外漫长。
就在众人等得心如油煎的时候。
一声嘹亮的婴儿啼哭声，从殿内传了出来！
哭声洪亮有力，震得殿宇都微微颤动。
与此同时，一股强横无比的气息从殿内冲天而起！
殿顶的金龙虚影瞬间凝实，发出一声震彻祖地的龙吟！
漫天金色的霞光洒落，将整个叶族祖地都笼罩在一片温暖的金光之中。
生了！
“生了！少夫人生了！是个男孩！”
产婆抱着襁褓，兴冲冲地从殿内跑了出来，脸上满是激动的笑容。
众人“呼啦”一下围了上去。
襁褓之中，一个粉雕玉琢的男婴正睁着一双金色的眼眸，好奇地打量着四周。
他的小脸红扑扑的，五官精致，面容跟叶无缺简直是一个模子里刻出来的。
content_en:
Even the ancestors Ye Zhetian and Ye Beichen, who had been sitting in the Konghai Sea of ​​No Return, rushed back together.
This big event is... Ye Wuque and Yu Jiaoxue's child, who has been pregnant for twelve hundred years, is finally going to be born!
Ye Wuque's descendant, this is so important.
It represents the continuation of Ye Wuque’s life.
Moreover, many Leaf Clan creatures already know that this unborn child is also a supreme monster that can subvert their cognition!
While still in his mother's womb, he had already absorbed the spiritual energy of heaven and earth on his own, practicing and enlightening the Tao. His aura was so strong that it had already surpassed the level of the Tao realm.
Now that the birth is imminent, the entire Xueyao Palace is shrouded in rays of light. There is a faint shadow of a golden dragon hovering on the top of the palace, and the sound of the dragon's roar can be faintly heard.
There are various visions, indicating that this child is extraordinary.
The courtyard outside Xueyao Hall was full of people.
The ancestor of Ye Zhetian was dressed in a green Taoist robe, with white beard and hair, but he was energetic. His eyes were fixed on the palace door, his hands were behind his back, but his fingertips were slightly tightened, showing his inner nervousness.
The ancestor Ye Beichen stood beside him, dressed in white, with a stern face, but the slight frown also revealed his uneasy mood.
The ancestor Ye Taishang stood at the front, his old face full of anticipation and anxiety.
Ancestors such as Tianzu, Xuanzu, Great Ancestor, and Seventh Ancestor, as well as patriarch Ye Jinghong, Seventh Elder and other core elders were also present.
Everyone held their breath and waited nervously for the birth of Ye Wuque's heir.
It was eerily quiet in the courtyard, and even the sound of breathing could be heard clearly.
Only in the hall, Yu Jiaoxue's suppressed groan of pain could occasionally be heard, tugging at everyone's heart.
"The Supreme Ancestor, do you think...the young lady and the young master will be fine?"
The seventh elder couldn't help but speak, his voice trembling slightly.
The ancestor Ye Taishang said in a deep voice:
"Auspicious people have their own destiny."
"Jiaoxue has a profound blessing, and her perfect child is her destiny. She will be safe and sound."
Having said that, the crutch he was holding tightly revealed his inner uneasiness.
Time passed by minute by minute.
Every moment seems extremely long.
Just when everyone was waiting so hard that their hearts were fried.
"Wow——!!!"
A loud cry of a baby came from the hall!
The cry was loud and powerful, causing the palace to tremble slightly.
At the same time, an extremely powerful aura soared into the sky from the palace!
The shadow of the golden dragon on the top of the hall solidified instantly, and let out a dragon roar that shook the ancestral land!
The golden glow spread across the sky, shrouding the entire Ye Clan's ancestral land in a warm golden light.
Give birth!
"Give birth! Madam, she gave birth! It's a boy!"
The midwife held the baby in her arms and ran out of the hall happily, with an excited smile on her face.
Everyone cheered and surrounded him.
Among the swaddling clothes, a pink-carved baby boy was looking around with a pair of golden eyes curiously.
His face was rosy, his facial features were delicate, and his face was exactly the same as Ye Wuque's.
title_en: Chapter 938 Ye Wushuang Chapter 937 Saving Huangxian
